results.notes: Code edits are written; compilation and tests are NOT yet confirmed. Design deviation: the plan's literal design (space_context.or(space_append_context) with a String token) breaks switch-off byte-identity, because an absent token and an empty one both deserialize to "" and "" suppresses grounding, while today's absent-decision follow-up is an unscoped org-wide search. To keep switch-off identical without touching the unowned session_flow.rs, sse.rs gains a second strict MG switch MODEL_GATEWAY_SPACE_APPEND_RETRIEVAL (default off) gating the append decision. BFF: GATEWAY_SPACE_APPEND_RETRIEVAL (strict == "true", default off) makes the append branch call retrieval-decision via the new helper space_retrieval_token; the first-turn path now uses the same helper with identical keys and semantics. Four sse.rs retrieval sites plus the verification site use space_retrieval_decision(space_context, space_append_context, enabled). Switch-off paths are byte-identical in both services. K3-18 says =false re-exposes org documents; with the MG switch on, BFF=false gives suppressed follow-ups instead, so re-exposure requires the MG switch off too.
